save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint to disk with epoch, updates, and validation loss metadata
load_checkpoint: load a checkpoint and restore the training iterator, optimizer state, and learning rate scheduler
load_checkpoint_to_cpu: load a checkpoint file to CPU memory with backward compatibility upgrades for older models
load_model_ensemble: load an ensemble of models from multiple checkpoint files with optional argument overrides
prune_state_dict: prune a model state dict to keep only specified encoder or decoder layers for LayerDrop inference
